values.system: several machines or devices working together
values.apparatus_and_method: a device and a way of using it, both presented as the invention

functions.verb.title: functions.verb: functional basis verbs (Hirtz et al. 2002, shortened). A flow is a material, an energy or a signal. Indented groups: use the general verb only when no specific verb under it fits

values.separate: general: isolate a flow, or parts of it, into distinct components. Specific: divide, extract, remove
values.divide: split one flow into two or more parts (e.g. cut a stem into two parts)
values.extract: draw or forcibly pull out a flow (e.g. pull roots out of soil)
values.remove: take a part of a flow away from its place (e.g. take leaves off a plant)
values.distribute: spread a flow out or break it up over several places
values.import: bring a flow in from outside the device
values.export: send a flow out of the device
values.transfer: general: move a flow from one place to another. Specific: transport, transmit
values.transport: move a material from one place to another
values.transmit: move an energy from one place to another
values.guide: general: direct a flow along a specific path. Specific: translate, rotate, allow_dof
values.translate: move a flow along one straight line
values.rotate: turn a flow about one axis
values.allow_dof: let a flow move freely in one or more directions
values.couple: general: bring flows together so they stay distinguishable. Specific: join, link
values.join: couple flows together in a fixed way
values.link: couple flows together through an intermediate part
values.mix: combine flows into one uniform mass
values.actuate: start a flow in response to a control signal
values.regulate: general: adjust a flow in response to a control signal. Specific: increase, decrease
values.increase: enlarge a flow in response to a control signal
values.decrease: reduce a flow in response to a control signal
values.change: general: adjust a flow in a fixed, predetermined way. Specific: increment, decrement, shape, condition
values.increment: enlarge a flow in a fixed way
values.decrement: reduce a flow in a fixed way
values.shape: mould or form a material into a shape
values.condition: make a flow fit for its intended use (e.g. clean, dry, cool)
values.stop: general: cease or block the transfer of a flow. Specific: prevent, inhibit
values.prevent: keep a flow from happening at all
values.inhibit: strongly restrain a flow while some of it still passes
values.convert: change a flow from one form into another (e.g. electrical into mechanical energy)
values.store: accumulate a flow and keep it for later
values.contain: keep a flow within limits (e.g. hold produce in a bin)
values.collect: bring a flow together into one place
values.sense: general: perceive a flow. Specific: detect, measure
values.detect: find out that something is present or what state it is in
values.measure: determine the size or amount of something
values.indicate: general: make something about a flow known to the user. Specific: track, display
values.track: observe and record data about a flow over time
values.display: show something about a flow to the eye
values.process: treat information by a set procedure (e.g. compute a position from images)
values.stabilize: keep a flow from changing its course or position
values.secure: fix a flow firmly in place (e.g. clamp, grip and hold)
values.position: place a material in a specific location or orientation

functions.flow.title: functions.flow: what the action mainly acts on

values.material: a physical object or substance, e.g. produce, soil, a picking head
values.energy: mechanical, electrical, hydraulic or other energy
values.signal: information, e.g. an image, a position, a control command

functions.actor.title: functions.actor: who performs the action, judged by the power source

values.energy_or_resource_use: fuel, power, water or other resource use

values.industrial_crop: harvesting crops grown as raw material for processing: cotton and other fiber crops, sugar beet, sugarcane, tobacco, hops, chicory root

values.pulling: the produce or plant is pulled until it comes off
